decision_engine.rule: All HTTP RBAC permission decisions enter this wrapper before UnifiedPermissionEngine.

guarantees: The same permission decision key is evaluated once per request.
Downstream middleware and dependencies reuse the cached decision object.
The same request does not re-query cached user, org membership, permission registry, assignment, role default, or module binding materials.

org_permissions: user plus active org membership joined context

short_lived_ttl_cache.test_namespace_safety: pytest current-test name is included in cache namespace when present to prevent cross-test stale reads.

invalidation.reason: RBAC data changes must not wait for TTL expiry before later requests observe them.

org_module: Reuse request org_context membership when it matches user_id and org_id.
Fallback user + active membership resolution uses one joined query.
Reuse request org_context.module_scope before querying module_bindings.
permission_key: Enabled assignment lookup uses the existing joined assignment/registry query and is cached.
Role default lookup is cached by normalized role.
auth_session: Middleware validated session is stored in request.state and reused by later middleware/dependencies.
